[[Rep/Legends|Rep]] '''Teers''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]], serving as a member of the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]] at the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==

===Early life===
Teers was responsible for monitoring [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga's]] power requirements, particularly those required to maintain its [[Hydrostatic field/Legends|hydrostatic fields]].<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> She communicated with the Gungan engineers who managed the [[Locap/Legends|locap]] roots that gave Otoh Gunga its power, making sure that the plant could handle the requirements of new additions to the city.<ref name="Databank" /> Teers guarded the ancient records of the Gungan culture and knew many secrets of existed long forgotten Gungan hideouts.

===Dealings on Naboo===
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], shortly after an incident at the [[Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility]], Rep Teers left in the Rep heyblibber, forcing [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and Commander [[Wollod (Gungan)|Wollod]] to use a tribubble bongo. A seaquake endangered Teers’ heyblibber and his life. She was saved by Jar Jarwho came to rescue the heyblibber from a creature before finally arriving at a bubble in Lake Umberbool. Teers, Nass, Wollod, and Fassa were later found, but Captain Tarpals still took Jar Jar into custody.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core">''[[Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core]]''</ref> Sometimes later, in the upcoming [[Festival of Warriors]], Rep Teers called Nass and told him that droids have been sighted in the area. Nass said that subduing a droid would give the competitors bonus points.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 10: Festival of Warriors">''[[Episode I Adventures 10: Festival of Warriors]]''</ref>

===The Invasion of Naboo===
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> she was present at the Council during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Nabbo]] sitting to the left of Nass, in particular when they first met the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name=":1">{{Film|I}}</ref> When the Gungans evacuated [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] during the invasion, Rep Teers and fellow official Rep [[Been]] stayed close to Nass.<ref name="Databank" />

==Personality and traits==
Teers's name was of Gungan origin. It was surname that shared its name with a local species of [[Teers (coral)|coral]].<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Teers was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The character was realized through computer-generation, and the  model of Rep Teers, like all the secondary Gungans, was designed using the model of Jar Jar Binks as a starting point.<ref name="Databank" /> She made her first appearance in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] of {{Film|I}}, authored by [[Terry Brooks]]<ref name=":0">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> and released on [[April 21]], [[1999]],<ref name="Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> where she was simply identified as one of the Gungan Council members.<ref name=":0" /> The film released after the book on [[May 19]], 1999.<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

The character was first identified as Teers in the [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]] written reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars:'' Episode I ''The Visual Dictionary'']],<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> published on [[September 15]], 1999.<ref name="DK">{{DK|subdomain=us|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,11_0789447010,00.html|text=Star Wars Episode 1: Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref> The [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]'', written by Reynolds and [[Jason Fry]], confirmed her<ref name=":2">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> to be the the Gungan representative sitting at the left of Boss Nass''.''<ref name=":1" />

In [[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game|''LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game'']] and [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|''LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga'']], two [[Canon|non-canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video games]] developed by [[Traveller's Tales]], only two Gungan Representatives are shown alongside Rugor Nass in the cutscenes based on Episode I.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''</ref><ref name="LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref> This article assumes that the one on his left is meant to be Teers.
